purpose: Teach: 執着/標的/浅草/鋼/富ん/気圧/献金/炭鉱

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 過去の成功への執着、新事業には、害になる。
lines.en: Attachment to past successes will only damage the new venture.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Slight weight on 「執着」. No meandering — each phrase lands. Cold clarity without coldness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、業界の競争で、標的にされやすい立場です。
lines.en: Yes. We're in a vulnerable position within the industry's competitive landscape.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Quick nod-beat on 「はい」. Controlled pace, acknowledging the difficulty without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 浅草の支店、観光客対応、強化しろ。
lines.en: Strengthen the Asakusa branch's capacity to serve tourist clientele.
lines.style: Firm instruction with no room for question. Crisp edge on the verb. Expects immediate understanding and execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。鋼材の調達、海外取引先と、契約済みです。
lines.en: Yes. We've already secured contracts with overseas steel suppliers.
lines.style: Clipped, professional update. Small pride in the groundwork already done. Efficient — no elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界経験に富んだ人材、積極的に、採用しろ。
lines.en: Hire experienced industry talent aggressively. Don't hesitate.
lines.style: Authoritative, almost urgent without raising volume. Emphasis on action now. The tone of someone who sees the window closing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外市場、気圧の変化に強い製品、開発中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're developing products that can withstand pressure fluctuations for the overseas market.
lines.style: Progress report delivered with quiet competence. Slight lift on the achievement — they're ahead. Professional precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 政治献金、当社、ガイドラインに沿って、行っています。
lines.en: Political contributions are conducted according to our corporate guidelines.
lines.style: Formal and measured. The tone of someone placing a marker for the record. No defensiveness, but deliberate clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。炭鉱跡地の活用、再エネプロジェクト、進めております。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with renewable energy projects on former mining sites.
lines.style: Final statement with weight. Quiet pride in the pivot — old industry becoming new. Closes with certainty.
